pages.text: The $(item)Backpack$() is a wearable bulk-storage item. It stores any mix of items in a single shared pool, tracking counts per item type with no per-stack limits. It starts at Wood tier and can be upgraded all the way to Netherite.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: $(bold)Right-click$() while holding the backpack to open its inventory UI.$(br2)$(bold)Sneak + right-click$() on a block face to place the backpack as a block. Right-click the placed block to pick it back up.$(br2)With the $(item)Curios$() mod installed, wear it in the $(thing)back$() slot. Press $(thing)B$() to open it from anywhere in your inventory.

pages.title: Upgrades
pages.text: Apply a $(item)Storage Upgrade$() to advance the backpack one tier at a time:$(br2)Wood → Copper → Iron → Gold → Diamond → Emerald → Netherite$(br2)Each tier significantly increases capacity.

pages.title: Other Upgrades
pages.text: $(bold)Crafting Upgrade$() — adds a crafting grid to the backpack UI.$(br2)$(bold)Magnet Upgrade$() — automatically collects dropped items within 3 blocks.$(br2)$(bold)Puller Upgrade$() — extracts items from adjacent inventories each tick.
